name: Haven Riviere Sands
accommodation: Caravans in Saver, Bronze and Signature grades, two or three bedrooms, sleeping four to eight
suitableFor: Families wanting entertainment and facilities on site
parking: Blue Badge spaces in the main complex
dogs: Not stated on the park page
beachAccess: Backs onto Towans beach above St Ives Bay, with direct beach access and wheelchair access by the main restaurant
confirmedFeatures: Indoor heated pool, entertainment venue, arcade, crazy golf, kids' clubs, supermarket and food outlets
overview: A large holiday park on the cliffs above St Ives Bay that backs directly onto the Towans beach. Caravans come in three grades, with two or three bedrooms. There is a heated indoor pool, evening entertainment, kids' clubs and several places to eat, plus a supermarket. Hayle station is just over a mile away.
surfTripFit: Direct beach access from the park means a short walk to the waves, with plenty to keep non-surfers busy.
